g.text: Assigned pump/system curves with10 m static rise and quadratic total losses. Head-line profile is schematic: pump adds20 m, pipe losses4.49 m, valve5 m,
exit velocity head .51 m. Reservoir velocity is negligible. Axial positions are illustrative; this profile and curves are not a surveyed installation.
